Variants.Content: In 209 BC, Scipio bypassed Carthaginian field armies to launch a lightning strike against their Iberian capital, Carthago Nova. Discovering that tidal shifts drained the adjacent lagoon, Scipio led five hundred legionaries wading through waist-deep waters to scale unguarded seawalls while assaulting the land gates. Capturing Carthage's military depots, silver bullion, and hostages, Scipio treated Iberian captives with magnanimity, winning their allegiance.
